evidence.reason: New function calls weights.allocationWeight(bytes, 0.1, 'image') and divides by weights.byteUnit, creating a value-reference to byteUnit that is part of the dependency path.
Rewritten to return { bytes: allocated * byteUnit } with category-dependent headers; byteUnit value-references weightDetails, so the merged behavior depends on this return shape and scaling.
Caller returns admittedAllocation(bytes), so any change in admittedAllocation's numeric contract propagates to this exported caller.
Caller interpolates admittedAllocation(bytes) into a label, so a changed numeric contract changes user-visible output.
Usage shows property access weightDetails(bytes, overhead, category).bytes, confirming the .bytes return property is consumed and must remain compatible.
